adjudicated.jp: 虫の音色も聞こえない。
adjudicated.en: The timbre of insects I can't hear either.
comments: As with the "unusable" appliances, he can't hear them. And he can't hear their TIMBRE, of all things. This is extremely suspicious. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese refers naturally to the sound or song of insects; 'timbre of insects' is possible only as an unusually literal and awkward reading.
